notes.title: Global Chat, New Missions & 30s Rounds
notes.content:
[h2]We’re excited to introduce our most feature-packed update yet, designed to boost competition, social interaction, and gameplay flow:[/h2]

[h1][list]
[*] 3 New Item-Reward Missions
[/list][/h1]
[h3]Complete these fresh challenges to earn special in-game items.
Engage daily to boost your inventory and progress.[/h3]

[h1][list]
[*] Steam Achievements
[/list][/h1]
[h3]Two brand-new achievements added to your Steam profile.
Prove your skills and share your milestones with friends.[/h3]

[h1][list]
[*] 30-Second Rounds
[/list][/h1]
[h3]Fast-paced action: each round now lasts just 30 seconds.
A 30 s intermission before the next round keeps the momentum high.[/h3]

[h1][list]
[*] Global Chat System
[/list][/h1]
[h3]Connect with players worldwide in real-time.
Share strategies, celebrate victories, or just hang out.[/h3]

[h1][list]
[*] Global Rewards Leaderboard
[/list][/h1]
[h3]Jump into a 2-week, prize-backed global ranking.
Climb the ladder and claim exclusive rewards every fortnight.[/h3]

[h1][list]
[*] 15 New Languages
[/list][/h1]
[h3]Full localization for 15 additional languages.
More players worldwide can enjoy the game in their native tongue.[/h3]

[h1][list]
[*] Refined UI & Animations
[/list][/h1]
[h3]Fresh, intuitive interface design.
Smooth transitions and feedback animations elevate your experience.[/h3]

[h1][list]
[*] Bug Fixes & Optimizations
[/list][/h1]
[h3]Squashed various minor glitches for greater stability.
Performance tweaks ensure seamless gameplay.[/h3]

[h2]Jump in now to experience these exciting additions—team up, compete, and chat your way to the top![/h2]
